fomod.Name: Scavenger Sense
fomod.Author: KShakes
fomod.Description:
Press a key and everything worth looting lights up in an outward wave, with a ring travelling across the ground from your feet, names floating over the objects, and the colour draining out of the world while it runs. Crouch first and the same sweep reads the ground: everyone the sense has touched leaves footprints, and marking a person - or their trail - keeps them trackable across cells. A scavenger's sense for Skyrim.
0.10.1 beta. Offline build, configuration and installer checks are recorded in the source reports; actual gameplay verification of the new features is still pending. Report problems with ScavengerSense.log.
Requires matching SKSE64 and Address Library, SKSE Menu Framework with the HUD exports and matching ImGui ABI (updated local 3.14 checked), and the included ScavengerSense.esp enabled.
